BiblicalUsage: This word means impudent or arrogant, and it describes hard speech against God and His people. Hannah warns against proud and arrogant talk, and the lying lips that speak grievous things against the righteous will be silenced.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that arrogant speech is not a small sin, because it lifts the neck against the very God who hears it.
